label: Wants another day
text: Can I come on a different day? Next week is bad for me.

label: Can't come because of work
text: Thursday doesn't work, I start work at 7. Is there anything on a Saturday or after 5?

label: Asks a medical question
text: Will the biopsy hurt? And how long until they know what it is?

label: Turns down the test
text: I've thought about it and I don't want the biopsy. Please take me off this list.

label: Wrong number
text: Sorry, wrong number. I don't know who that is.

label: No one to watch her kids
text: I can't come in during the day, there's nobody to watch my kids.
